name: abdm-integrators-assistant
description: Agent skills for ABDM integration from the ABDM Developer Portal, compiled from the Catalogue. Build skills scaffold a milestone flow by flow against the sandbox: hiecm-m1-build to hiecm-m4-build on the provider side, hiecm-p1-build to hiecm-p3-build inside a PHR application. Debug skills walk a failed call to a named fix: hiecm-m1-debug to hiecm-m4-debug, and hiecm-p1-debug for the whole patient side, since NHA records the PHR error codes once. Each cites the atom it came from. Hand-authored: fhir-generate builds NRCES compliant FHIR document bundle generation into the integrator's codebase, fhir-audit checks an existing FHIR store's output.
